# proportion has a high margin of error and should be used with caution
n.p not available for publication as estimate has a relative standard error greater than 50%, but included in the totals where applicable, unless otherwise stated.
Cells in this table use ABS published data which have been randomly adjusted to avoide the release of confidential data. Discrepancies may occur between sums of the component items and totals.
See the ABS methodology for definitions of sweetened beverages
1. Sex recorded at birth refers to what was determined by sex characteristics observed at birth or infancy.
2.  Includes persons whose sex recorded at birth was another term (other than male or female).
3. 2023 data excludes very remote areas of Australia.
4.  Includes beverages reported as consumed on day prior to interview (Day 1).

5. Collection methods and inclusion of types of drinks vary across surveys which may affect comparability. For information on detailed changes, see Table 14 People who consumed sweetened beverages, by age and sex, 1995, 2011–12 and 2023, from the ABS publication Sweetened beverages, 2023.
6. 95% CI = 95% confidence interval. We can be 95% confident that the true value is within this confidence interval.
